description: Today, Michael Whatley Hosted a Make More Keep More press conference in Bolivia. Whatley and local leaders discussed how costs rose under Cooper’s watch including healthcare, energy, and housing. Whatley also covered how Cooper will take the same tax and spend agenda to Washington, where he will make life cost more for every single North Carolina family.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts Make More Keep More Press Conference In Brunswick County – Michael Whatley for Senate
